versions.subject: feat: new rules related to snake malware
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|contains: '\SOFTWARE\Classes\.wav\OpenWithProgIds\'
filter_main_wav:
    - TargetObject|endswith: '.AssocFile.WAV'
    - TargetObject|endswith: '.wav.'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
